utterance: Create an AWS CodeBuild project with an example IAM role, an example GITHUB source, artifacts stored in the existing S3 bucket whose name starts with `build-artifacts-`, and a cache.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: a new CodeBuild project builds from a GITHUB source, has a cache configured, writes its build artifacts (type S3, not NO_ARTIFACTS) into the pre-existing build-artifacts- bucket, and runs as a new IAM role that trusts codebuild.amazonaws.com
